name: Choukou Sentai Justice Blade 3 ~Altered Apocalypse~
original_name: 超光戦隊ジャスティスブレイド3～アルタード アポカリプス～
source:
The main character is the boss of an evil society. His group once destroyed the Justice Blade by attacking heroines one by one. His ambition is to conquer the world. However, the Justice Blade is now re-formed. When these two groups are about to have a battle, a devil group appears. Since their power is overwhelming, humans are put into a corner. Alliance with the Justice Blade or the devil group? His new battle now starts...

[From ErogeShop]
